italy.summary: Buy directly where no agent commission is owed; compare itemised notary quotes, check prima casa and prezzo-valore eligibility, and use a technician for planning and cadastral conformity.
italy.savings: Ask about the statutory notarial-fee reduction for eligible prezzo-valore transactions. A separate preliminary contract may be unnecessary for an immediate purchase, but do not waive protections where checks or financing are outstanding.
italy.warning: Tax relief and prezzo-valore do not necessarily apply to ruins, F/2 buildings or agricultural land. Obtain case-specific advice before committing.

resources.title: Agenzia delle Entrate - buying a home

slovenia.summary: A direct seller purchase can avoid agent commission. For straightforward sales, compare quotes for contract review, signature certification and registration rather than assuming a full notarial deed is required.
slovenia.savings: Check who contractually bears real-estate transfer tax, usually the seller for applicable transfers. Compare itemised professional quotes and avoid duplicate legal services.
slovenia.warning: Agricultural land and forests may involve administrative approval and statutory pre-emption rights. New builds or VAT transactions have different tax treatment.
